handoff.handoff_instruction:
When security review is complete and all Critical/High findings are resolved (user approved), determine next mode by pipeline:
**Brownfield-fix-bug:** Use attempt_completion to return to orchestrator. Do NOT hand off to deploy. The orchestrator will ask the user "Does this fix require deployment?" and delegate to deploy only if yes. Include security-review.md, code-review.md, and architecture.md (if exists) in the completion summary.
**Normal pipeline:** Validate deploy prerequisites (architecture.md, codebase, security-review.md, code-review.md) are ready. Then use new_task with mode=deploy and message including: - ARCHITECTURE_FILE: architecture.md - Codebase location - security-review.md (scan results and assessment) - code-review.md (quality decisions) - REPO_STRATEGY: single|multi — Pass through from handoff or architecture.md so Deploy handles per-repo deployment when multi. - REPO_DIRS (when multi): Pass through from handoff or architecture.md so Deploy knows which repo dirs to deploy. - Instruction to create deployment plan (infrastructure, environment strategy, CI/CD, config, observability) for human review before deployment execution See handoff-schema.md.
